name: Balsamic Roasted Pork with Grapes, Carrot Fritters & Basil Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg red grapes
9 medium carrots
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Halve grapes and place in a large bowl.

Pat pork chops dry with paper towels. Large dice and add to the bowl with the grapes along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Stir to combine, divide between two large baking dishes, and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 ½ tsp sage, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dishes in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until pork is cooked through and grapes are soft, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place eggs, milk, and oil in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
177 ml whole milk
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add flour, salt, and baking powder to the bowl with the egg mixture. Whisk once more until the batter is just combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp baking powder

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the batter and gently stir until incorporated.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; flatten slightly with the back of a spoon. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into a small bowl.

Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the lemon juice along with yogurt and spices. Stir to combine the yogurt sauce and set aside. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp garlic powder
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide pork, grapes, and carrot fritters between plates. Sprinkle pork with reserved basil and serve with yogurt sauce on the side. Enjoy!
